Thirty-three-year-old Esmeralda was waiting for a bus on her way home, unknown to the fact that, miles away at that same moment, two officers were conducting a traffic stop on a suspect with incorrect registration information, and that the suspect was about to take them on a chase. The very chase because of which Esmeralda would never be able to go home to her kids.
